problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with velocity $v(t)=\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t),$ where $t$ is the time. If the particle is at the position $x=3$ when $t=0,$ calculate the position $x$ of the particle at time $t>0.$

activity_context.topic_title: Calculating the Position Function of a Particle Using Integration

feedback.worked_solution:
We start by integrating the velocity to get $x(t):$

$$
\begin{aligned}x(t) & =\int v(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\int 5\,\text{d}t \\  & =5t+C\end{aligned}
$$

To determine $C$, we use the fact that $x(3)=-2.$ Substituting this into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}-2 & =5(3)+C \\ -2 & =15+C \\ C & =-17.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the position $x$ of the particle at time $t$ is 

$$
x(t)=5t-17.
$$
